metadata.case_name: RUKHSAR BEGUM v. NATIVE ENGLISH CENTER LTD T/A THE GREEN LOUNGE

plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: office clerk, a cashier or a receptionist
plaintiff.education_level: educated in Hong Kong up to Form 5

injuries.description: fracture of the base of the distal phalanx of the right ring finger (healed with mild mal-union)
source: there was in fact a fracture of the base of the distal phalanx of the finger even though the fracture had already healed quite well with mild mal-union at the time of his review of the films.

injuries.description: meniscal tear of the right knee (classified as "grade 2")
source: Dr Li classified the meniscal tear of the right knee as “grade 2[12]”.
it was stated in the MRI report that the knee had a “possible tear of posterior horn of medical meniscus”.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

source: she had suffered from “right traumatic patellar tendinitis”
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of anterior muscle group at lower leg level

manifestations.description: tender and swollen right ring finger and knee with a reduced range of movement
limping gait; could walk unaided for about 15 minutes with limping gait
mild stiffness of right ring finger
discomfort from continuous bending or standing for 4 hours or more; unable to stand for more than 4 hours

treatments_received: treatment and discharge on same day with a knee brace and walking stick
four follow-up sessions with the Orthopaedics & Traumatology Department on 2 December 2013, 24 February 2014, 3 March 2014 and 23 June 2014
two physiotherapy treatments for the knee injury on 16 and 23 December 2013
treatments_future: use of "Power Putty" exercises for finger strengthening (total cost $450 for set)

losses.description: Reduced function of the right knee and right ring finger resulting in pain, swelling, reduced range of movement and mild mal-union of the finger
Unable to resume pre-accident waitressing job due to residual pain in the right knee and difficulty standing for more than 4 hours
